seoTitle: How to Integrate Clockify With Asana Easily
metaDescription: Learn how to connect Clockify to Asana in 2026 with a browser extension, so you can start timers and log hours right from inside your Asana tasks.
intro: Switching between separate apps just to track billable hours breaks your workflow, and Clockify's browser extension solves that by embedding a timer directly into Asana tasks. This guide covers installing the extension, enabling the Asana integration, and syncing tracked hours back to your Clockify dashboard.

steps.heading: Install the Clockify browser extension
steps.body: Open your browser's extension marketplace and install the official Clockify extension.

steps.heading: Log in and open extension settings
steps.body: Sign into your Clockify account through the extension and open its settings menu.

steps.heading: Enable the Asana integration toggle
steps.body: Navigate to the Integrations tab inside the extension settings and switch on the Asana toggle.

steps.heading: Refresh Asana and open a task
steps.body: Reload your Asana workspace and open a task to reveal the embedded Clockify Start Timer button inside the task panel.

steps.heading: Track time and verify the sync
steps.body: Start and stop the timer from within Asana, then check the Clockify dashboard to confirm hours, task names, and project tags synced correctly.

faq.question: Do I need a paid Clockify plan for the Asana integration?
faq.answer: The browser extension and basic Asana integration work with Clockify's free tier, though advanced reporting features may require a paid plan.

faq.question: Can I edit time entries after tracking them?
faq.answer: Yes, you can manage manual time entries and adjust tracked hours directly from the Clockify web dashboard.

faq.question: Will project tags carry over automatically?
faq.answer: Yes, the integration syncs task names and project tags along with tracked hours in real time.

faq.question: Does the timer work across every browser?
faq.answer: It works in whichever browser has the Clockify extension installed, so you'll need to install it separately if you switch browsers.
